recommendations.body: `_offer_missing_intents()` in `plan_tool/create.py` (step 5 "Offer the proposed intent in the create wizard when the seed, `--from` text, or interactive path supplies none") returns at its `if not kept:` guard before reaching the `save_checkpoint` block, so an interactive walk in which the operator declines every draft persists no `create-intent` checkpoint. When the create then fails at the fail-loud `_(TODO)_` body gate — the failure the detail names as the reason to checkpoint at all — the cleanup block preserves checkpoints for the re-run, and the resumed run re-spends the `propose_intents` round-trip and re-asks every accept/edit/decline question already answered. The sibling `_review_step_gates()` this pass is modeled on saves its reviewed list unconditionally, including the drop-everything outcome.
recommendations.suggested_action: in `_offer_missing_intents()`, compute `reviewed = apply_intent_drafts(plan, kept)` and run the checkpoint-save block ahead of the `if not kept:` early return, returning `reviewed` with the `all_declined` skip reason intact
